svg.title: Vardhman School Uniforms Application Architecture
svg.desc: Layered architectural flowchart showing server layouts, client interactive components, hydration-safe context stores, data services, static assets, and reactive feedback loops.

g.text: Next.js 16 App Router • React 19 Server Components • useSyncExternalStore
RootLayout, App Router pages, metadata declarations & viewport theme tags
SSR pre-rendering, static HTML generation, zero client bundle weight for static views
✓ Suspense boundaries protect async Header and dynamic drawers
Strictly scoped "use client" islands at interactive DOM boundaries
⚡ Dispatches user actions (add-to-cart, wishlist toggle, profile updates)
Engineered with React 19's useSyncExternalStore with deterministic server snapshots
🛡️ Zero hydration flash • Synchronous storage event subscriptions across tabs
Catalog datasets (products, schools, categories, orders, hero slides)
Service abstraction modules (productService, schoolService, orderService, apiClient)
📦 Clean separation: UI components consume service facades without tight coupling
Tailwind CSS v4 engine (@theme in globals.css) • Google Fonts (Roboto & Inter variable)
⚙️ Single source of truth for motion intervals, theme tokens & typography scale
All layers strictly maintain pure JavaScript ES2024 standards with zero TypeScript build overhead.
